mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_sys_inbox_recipient (message_id, user_id, received_time, read_status, read_time) SELECT #{messageId}, a.id, #{receivedTime}, FALSE, NULL FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.enabled = TRUE ON CONFLICT (message_id, user_id, received_time) DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO t_sys_inbox_recipient (message_id, user_id, received_time, read_status, read_time) SELECT #{messageId}, a.id, #{receivedTime}, FALSE, NULL FROM t_sys_user a WHERE a.enabled = TRUE AND a.id IN #{userId} ON CONFLICT (message_id, user_id, received_time) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT a.message_id, b.title, b.content, b.level, b.sender_name, a.read_status, a.read_time, TO_CHAR(a.received_time, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.US') AS received_time, b.expire_time, b.resource_type, b.resource_id, b.action_code, b.action_payload FROM t_sys_inbox_recipient a INNER JOIN t_sys_inbox_message b ON b.id = a.message_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.message_id = #{messageId} AND a.received_time = CAST(#{receivedTime} AS timestamp) AND b.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND b.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.update:
UPDATE t_sys_inbox_recipient SET read_status = #{readStatus}, read_time = CASE WHEN #{readStatus} THEN COALESCE(read_time, #{readTime}) ELSE NULL END WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND (received_time, message_id) IN
(CAST(#{receipt.receivedTime} AS timestamp), #{receipt.messageId})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT 1 FROM t_sys_inbox_recipient a INNER JOIN t_sys_inbox_message b ON b.id = a.message_id WHERE a.user_id = #{userId} AND a.received_time >= #{beginTime} AND a.read_status = FALSE AND b.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND b.expire_time > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP LIMIT #{limit} ) capped
